subject: EZDRIVE | raw rank205

evidence.finding: EZdrive current public network supports badge/QR direct charging and states pricing combines time + energy.

2026 CGVU defines EZDRIVE as recharge-service provider and makes the current tariff sheet/app authoritative.

reopenCondition: EZdrive tariff sheet with deterministic territory/power mapping for exact EVSE or supported guest app/API payload.
fallback: Electra then Electroverse only as roaming fallback where compatible
